notes: Aggregate bit rate 103.1 Gb/s (all wavelengths combined). Maximum distance 70 m on OM3 and 100 m on OM4 requires FEC on the host per 100GBASE-SR4. Stressed Receiver Sensitivity (OMA) -5.2 dBm applies under stated stressed eye conditions (SEC 4.3 dB, J2/J4 jitter, aggressor OMA 3 dBm).
